description: The aim of the project is to obtain systematic knowledge on what importance the Norwegian level has for transition to work. The project shall examine how language requirements are used in different branches, how Norwegian proficiencies are assessed in practice, and what characterises employers who are successful in including people with limited Norwegian abilities. The project shall also analyse what factors contribute to immigrants coming in and staying in work, despite limited Norwegian proficiencies. The knowledge shall provide a better basis for understanding how language can function both as a door opener and barrier to participation in working life, and should be able to be used in policy development and to strengthen IMDi's guidance work and cooperation with employers, municipalities and other relevant actors. This can, among other things, contribute to more precise and flexible language requirements, clearer distinctions between oral and written skills and better adaptations of language requirements for specific work assignments. Valmennusten tavoitteena on tukea asiakkaiden työllistymistä, työelämävalmiuksien vahvistumista, osaamisen tunnistamista sekä etenemistä kohti työelämää, koulutusta tai muuta tarkoituksenmukaista palvelua. title: Finland – Software package and information systems – Family Pedigree Software Solution
description: The HUS Group requests tenders for family pedigree software solution mainly for the Clinical Genetics Unit. The procured software must be an on-premises, ready-to-use solution installed and operated within HUS-managed infrastructure and environment. The scope of the procurement includes software licences, implementation services, and related maintenance and support services required for the operational use of the software. The software will be used on a daily basis by approximately 20 to 30 users mainly within the Clinical Genetics Unit, including both physicians and nurses. In addition, a small number of users from the cardiology specialty will use the system. The family pedigree software is a critical tool in the Clinical Genetics Unit's daily operations. Information concerning almost all patients and families treated by the unit is recorded in the software. The Clinical Genetics Unit receives approximately 150 to 200 patient visits per week. The information stored in the software is of long-term clinical significance. When new patients from previously recorded families contact the Clinical Genetics Unit, often after several years, access to historical family data is essential. Therefore, reliable data preservation, availability, and retrievability are key requirements of the procurement. Laboratory system integration may be procured as an optional service and implemented as separately ordered expert work at the hourly expert rates specified in the Pricing Appendix. HANKKEEN KUVAUS Uusi koulukeskus on Kemiönsaaren kunnan merkittävä strateginen toimitilahanke ja kunnan kaikkien aikojen suurin yksittäinen investointi. Hankkeen tavoitteena on toteuttaa nykyaikainen, terveellinen, turvallinen, toimiva ja kestävän kehityksen periaatteita tukeva koulukeskus, joka vastaa kunnan opetustoimen tuleviin tarpeisiin sekä vahvistaa Kemiönsaaren elinvoimaa ja houkuttelevuutta. Nykyinen koulukeskus on tullut elinkaarensa päähän, eikä sen peruskorjaamista ole alustavien selvitysten perusteella pidetty taloudellisesti tarkoituksenmukaisena vaihtoehtona. Hankkeessa korostuvat kaksikielisen opetuksen, yhteiskäyttöisten tilojen, pedagogisesti joustavien oppimisympäristöjen, henkilöstön työskentelyolosuhteiden sekä oppilaiden turvallisuuden ja hyvinvoinnin vaatimukset. ALUSTAVA AIKATAULU - 2026: Tarveselvitys, kaavoitus ja tilaselvitys - 2027: Kaavoitus ja rakennuslupien suunnittelu - 2028: Toteutussuunnittelu - 2029–2030: Rakentamisvaihe Aikataulu on alustava ja tarkentuu hankkeen edetessä, erityisesti sijoituspaikkaa, kaavoitusta, tilalaajuutta, toteutusmuotoa, rahoitusta sekä hankkeen päätöksentekoa koskevien ratkaisujen perusteella. Rakennuttajakonsultti vastaa palveluntuottajan tehtäväkokonaisuuden johtamisesta sekä toimii hankintayksikön ensisijaisena yhteyshenkilönä hankkeen rakennuttamistehtävissä. Hankkeesta vastaavan rakennuttajakonsultin tulee olla koulutukseltaan arkkitehti. description: Synopsis N3943027R4001 - Manned Hyperbaric Systems Support Services This notice is a synopsis and does NOT constitute a request for proposal, request for quote, or invitation for bid. The Naval Facilities Engineering and Expeditionary Warfare Center (NAVFAC EXWC), Port Hueneme, California intends to issue a request for proposal (RFP) under solicitation number N3943027R4001 for an Indefinite Delivery, Indefinite Quantity (IDIQ), Multiple Award Contract (MAC). The work involved includes Manned Hyperbaric Systems Support Services in support of the Ashore Hyperbaric and Diving Systems product group�s projects involving various shore-based manned hyperbaric systems at Navy and Department of War (DoW) installations worldwide. The work will be performed worldwide at all shore-based locations where design, fabrication, installation, inspection, maintenance, repair, and overhaul operations may be needed to support NAVFAC EXWC customers. The Ashore Hyperbaric and Diving Systems product group conducts development, fabrication, test, evaluation, inspection, maintenance, and repair of manned hyperbaric systems, recompression chamber facilities, diver training facilities, escape trainer facilities, hyperbaric medical facilities, surface-supplied diving facilities, piping systems, Pressure Vessels for Human Occupancy (PVHOs), and high-pressure charging systems. More details of the requirement can be found in the attached Performance Work Statement. Market research was conducted in December 2025, and it was determined that there were not a sufficient number of small businesses capable of performing the scope of work. Therefore, a small business set-aside is not feasible. The NAICS Code for this procurement is 811310 � Commercial and Industrial Machinery and Equipment (except Automotive and Electronic) Repair and Maintenance, and the size standard is $12,500,000 (millions of Dollars). The Product Service Code (PSC) is J020 � Maintenance, Repair & Rebuilding of Ship and Marine Equipment. The market research determined to solicit this procurement as a full and open competition procurement. The Government intends to award the resulting contract to up to four (4) contractors. The Government will give fair consideration to all awardees in placing orders based on criteria stated in the solicitation. The contract term will be a base period of sixty (60) months or five (5) years and an optional 6-month extension in accordance with FAR 52.217-8 (Option to Extend Services). Only the base period of the contract will offer a minimum guarantee. If the Government does not award a follow-on contract in time, the Government may require the Contractor to continue performance for an additional period up to six (6) months under the Option to Extend Services clause. This is not a new requirement and will be a follow-on requirement. The services are currently being provided under contract N39430-21-D-2232 (Manned Hyperbaric Systems Support Services), awarded to Epsilon Systems Solutions, Inc. A six-month option under FAR 52.217-8 was exercised, extending the period of performance through 22 March 2027. The estimated value of this contract is $25,600,000. Offerors must be registered in the System for Award Management (SAM) at http://www.sam.gov in order to receive an award under this procurement. All questions concerning this solicitation shall be addressed to Alejandro L. Lopez via email at alejandro.l.lopez11.civ@us.navy.mil and Antonio M. Arias via email at antonio.m.arias.civ@us.navy.mil. description: This requirement is to procure the Precisely products and licenses for continued use within the Internal Revenue Service (IRS) in support of the Unified Application Programming Interface (UAPI) effort.
